details.title: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT

governing_law_source.quote:
This Agreement is governed by the laws of India.
11.2 The courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

details.parties_quote:
This Independent Contractor Agreement ("Agreement") is made on ____________, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between:

AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the "Company"); and

Marcus Reed, an individual residing at 1847 West Roscoe Street, Apt 3B, Chicago, Illinois 60657, USA, PAN: ____________ (the "Contractor").

payment_source.quote: The Contractor shall raise an invoice for approved hours. Payment shall be made within sixty (60) days after the date of timesheet approval.

details.services_summary: Data engineering for US retail analytics client including cloud lakehouse migration, ingestion pipelines, and support for semantic layer.

liability_cap.basis: fees payable for the preceding three (3) months
liability_cap.quote: The Company's liability to the Contractor shall not exceed the fees payable for the preceding three (3) months.

details.one_sided_note: Confidentiality obligations in Clause 7 bind the Contractor only.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Contractor shall not provide software or data services in competition with the Company anywhere in the world.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: provide any software or data services to any person, whether as an employee, consultant, contractor, partner or otherwise, in competition with the Company
restrictive_covenants.quote: For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Contractor shall not, anywhere in the world, directly or indirectly, provide any software or data services to any person, whether as an employee, consultant, contractor, partner or otherwise, in competition with the Company.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Contractor shall not solicit or accept work from company clients or solicit any employee.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: solicit or accept work from any client of the Company for whom he performed Services, or solicit any employee of the Company
restrictive_covenants.quote: For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry, the Contractor shall not solicit or accept work from any client of the Company for whom he performed Services, or solicit any employee of the Company.

restrictive_covenants.summary: All work product vests in the Company upon creation and is assigned to the Company.
restrictive_covenants.quote: All work product, code, pipelines, documentation, reports and other materials created by the Contractor in the course of the Services ("Work Product") shall vest in the Company upon creation. 6.2 The Contractor hereby assigns to the Company all present and future right, title and interest in the Work Product, including all intellectual property rights, worldwide and for the full term of such rights, and waives any moral rights therein.

findings.title: AtliQ Pvt Ltd named for a US client
findings.why: US clients contract with AtliQ Inc.
findings.comparison: Entity sheet: AtliQ Inc serves the United States only.
findings.quote:
This Independent Contractor Agreement ("Agreement") is made on ____________, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between:

AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the "Company"); and

Marcus Reed, an individual residing at 1847 West Roscoe Street, Apt 3B, Chicago, Illinois 60657, USA, PAN: ____________ (the "Contractor").

findings.title: Full-time exclusivity requirement
findings.why: This prevents AtliQ from engaging other clients or projects, significantly limiting business flexibility.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles do not support exclusivity clauses.
findings.quote: the Contractor shall devote his professional working time exclusively to the Company and shall not, directly or indirectly, provide services to, or be engaged or employed by, any other person

findings.title: Assignment of all IP including pre-existing tools
findings.why: This clause does not carve out AtliQ's pre-existing tools, potentially forcing AtliQ to hand over its own proprietary software.
findings.comparison: Standard contracts protect AtliQ's pre-existing tools; this is a significant deviation.
findings.quote: The Contractor hereby assigns to the Company all present and future right, title and interest in the Work Product, including all intellectual property rights

findings.title: Global non-compete clause
findings.why: This is an extremely broad, global non-compete that restricts AtliQ's ability to conduct business.
findings.comparison: AtliQ does not typically agree to non-competes.
findings.quote: the Contractor shall not, anywhere in the world, directly or indirectly, provide any software or data services to any person... in competition with the Company.

findings.title: Unfair termination notice period
findings.why: The 24-hour notice period is highly restrictive compared to the Contractor's 60-day notice requirement.
findings.comparison: Highly asymmetrical compared to standard termination clauses.
findings.quote: The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving twenty-four (24) hours' written notice

findings.title: Payment in 60 days
findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
findings.quote: The Contractor shall raise an invoice for approved hours. Payment shall be made within sixty (60) days after the date of timesheet approval.

findings.title: Unilateral exchange rate determination
findings.why: Allows the client to set the exchange rate, creating financial uncertainty for AtliQ.
findings.comparison: Unusual; typically market rates are used.
findings.quote: converted at an exchange rate determined by the Company at its discretion on the date of payment.

findings.title: CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform
findings.why: The deal involves a data platform; the client is outside India and the GCC, so this is probably allowed (clause 7.3), but confirm no partner fee is involved.
findings.comparison: Do not partner with another cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse vendor in India or the GCC while the CloudSpan agreement runs.
findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 7.3: does not restrict services outside India and the GCC, or to a customer that independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and receives no fee from, that platform's provider.

findings.title: Broad IP assignment
findings.why: Does not explicitly carve out AtliQ's pre-existing tools or background IP.
findings.comparison: Standard contracts usually protect pre-existing tools.
findings.quote: All work product, code, pipelines, documentation, reports and other materials created by the Contractor in the course of the Services ("Work Product") shall vest in the Company upon creation.

findings.title: Unilateral confidentiality obligations
findings.why: The confidentiality obligation is one-sided and does not bind the Company to protect AtliQ's confidential information.
findings.quote: The Contractor shall keep confidential all information relating to the Company

findings.title: Payment limited to approved hours
findings.why: Payment is restricted to 'approved' hours, which could allow the Company to withhold payment for completed work.
findings.comparison: Standard contracts usually pay for all work performed up to termination.
findings.quote: the Company shall pay for approved hours up to the termination date

findings.title: One-sided indemnity
findings.why: The indemnity is one-way, protecting only the Company.
findings.quote: The Contractor shall indemnify the Company against losses arising from the Contractor's breach

findings.title: Unilateral restriction on assignment
findings.why: This restricts AtliQ's ability to assign the contract to an affiliate or successor without consent, which is standard but restrictive.
findings.comparison: Most contracts allow assignment to affiliates or successors; this is a total prohibition.
findings.quote: The Contractor may not assign this Agreement.

findings.title: Stamp duty burden on Contractor
findings.why: AtliQ is the Company, yet the clause imposes the stamp duty cost on the Contractor (Marcus Reed).
findings.comparison: Usually, the Company bears the stamp duty for service agreements in Maharashtra.
findings.quote: Stamp duty on this Agreement, if any, shall be borne by the Contractor as per the Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958.
